notes.title: Ragna Maya Update v1.2.0 - Christmas Update
notes.content:
[b]Update v1.2.0 fixes, changes, and additions to gameplay, battle mechanics, damage formulas, drop rates, and animations. [/b]

[h1][b]Update Fixes and Changes[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Quantity Limit, changed item quantity limit from 250 to 999, excluding 'Mana Fragments'.
[*]Memoriam Quest Item, fixed the 'Ore of Agresha' battle reward after defeating a 'Golonakh Troll' in the Xeralia Winter Cliffs.
[*]Memoriam Quest Item, fixed the treasure chest guarded by the 'Hastur' in the Xeralia Winter Cliffs and now contains the Memoriam Quest Item 'Ore of Agresha'.
[*]Memoriam Quest Item, fixed the problem where it was possible to get an 'Ore of Agresha' battle reward more than once from the same Akasha.
[*]Battle Rewards, fixed the battle reward obtained for defeating an 'Arachguhl' in the 12th Floor of Helios.
[*]Treasure Chests, fixed the treasure chest problem where 4 chests gave the same item in The Dragon King's Grave.
[*]Combatant Animation, fixed 'Gigant' death animation.
[*]Combatant Animation, fixed 'Gargus' cast animation.
[*]Combatant Animation, fixed 'Istil' attack animation.
[*]Spell Animation, fixed 'Aquia' spell bug where the spell wouldn't end.
[*]Damage Output, adjusted weapon bonuses given by Tier III Weapons and above.
[*]Damage Output, adjusted a few damage formulas to bring better game balance.
[*]Status Developments, adjusted the base stats of the 'Witchspawn'.
[*]Tutorials, changed the information given by the tutorials in correspondence with the fixes made in Update v1.2.0
[/list]

[b]Hope you enjoy your Steam Christmas! [/b]

notes.title: Ragna Maya Update v1.1.0 - Major Update
notes.content:
[b]Update v1.1.0 fixes, changes, and additions to gameplay, battle mechanics, damage formulas, drop rates, and animations. [/b]

[h1][b]Update Fixes and Changes[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Controls, changed the cancel/exit button from '/' to 'C'.
[*]Damage Output, fixed problems where enemies were overpowered by adjusting the damage formulas and enemy attributes.
[*]Mirage Crystallisation, Crystals are no longer consumed when crystallising a Mirage, but a Crystal is still needed as a catalyst to perform crystallisation.
[*]Random Battle Frequency changed to have longer intervals between battles.
[*]Drop Rates, increased the drop rates of items to drop occasionally.
[*]Drop Rates, increased the amount of Aura and Mana Fragments earned after each battle.
[*]Mana Damage, increased the damage caused by 'Mana Burst'.
[*]Cancel or Back button fixed in the Aura Network and Save Point Menus.
[*]Equipment Menu, added an attribute preview change to show how much of a certain attribute increases/decreases.
[*]Animations, fixed Revenant (Party Member) death.
[*]Shop, added Crystal to the Aura Network.
[*]Starting Currency, added 5000 Aura as starting amount.
[*]Tutorials, changed the information given by the tutorials in correspondence with the fixes made in Update v1.1.0
[/list]

[b]Hope you enjoy your Steam Halloween! [/b]

notes.title: Fate, or Coincidence? Released on Steam for $9.95 this week only!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Released on Steam![/h1][/b]

Grab it for less than $10 while you can!

Just as I was finishing up on the Steam Achievements implementation on the game, I got the [b]Approval[/b] from Steam! Is this fate, or coincidence? I think it's fate! I apologize for the wait and I would like you to enjoy this JRPG. Feel free to post in the Community Hub!

If you'd like, I'll make a guide for those that can't seem to advance in the game.

Yours truly,
Peter Leonar Junior

[b]P.S. Follow me on twitter for updates on new games and more![/b]
https://twitter.com/Ragna_Maya
